title: Client Connector performance runbook: ISP UDP throttling and moving a user to TLS or the hybrid profile

isp-deprioritizes-udp.statement: The runbook reports that certain ISPs deprioritize UDP traffic; DTLS, the primary transport for Z-Tunnel 2.0, uses UDP 443, and deprioritization can cause overall sluggishness.

quotes: certain ISPs deprioritize UDP-based traffic
DTLS is the primary transport protocol for Z-Tunnel 2.0, and DTLS uses UDP 443.
Deprioritization can result in network traffic performance issues such as overall internet sluggishness.

switch-to-tls-user-override.statement: To switch a user to TLS from the local page, enable Allow end user to override Z-Tunnel 2.0 or ZPA protocol settings under User Privacy, browse to http://127.0.0.1:9000/zconfig?q=@<CustomerDomain>, select TLS as the Protocol, and click Restart Service in the More window.

quotes: go to Infrastructure > Connectors > Client > User Privacy
With Zscaler Client Connector turned on, browse to http://127.0.0.1:9000/zconfig?q=@<CustomerDomain>
enable the Allow end user to override Z-Tunnel 2.0 or ZPA protocol settings option.
select TLS as the Protocol in the drop-down menu:
To enable these changes, click Restart Service in the More window of Zscaler Client Connector.
evidence.after: The following steps describe switching user to Z-Tunnel 2.0 / TLS:

switch-to-tls-profile.statement: The profile route to TLS creates a new forwarding profile with Primary Transport Selection set to TLS, maps it to a new app profile and the affected user, and the user clicks Update Policy.

quotes: You must create a new app profile and a new forwarding profile.
In the new forwarding profile, select the Primary Transport Selection as TLS.
Map this new forwarding profile to the newly created app profile.
Map the affected user to this new app profile.
Users must click Update Policy in Zscaler Client Connector to be assigned to the new profile.
evidence.after: ## Option 2: Switching Users to Z-Tunnel 2.0 or TLS

tls-improvement-meaning.statement: If performance improves on TLS, the runbook says the ISP is throttling UDP packets and to contact the ISP; Z-Tunnel 2.0 with TLS can still intercept all ports and protocols like DTLS.

quotes: If the performance improves, it indicates that the ISP is throttling UDP packets. Contact the ISP and work towards resolution.
Z-Tunnel 2.0 with TLS can still intercept all ports and protocols, just like Z-Tunnel 2.0 with DTLS.

hybrid-configuration.statement: Client Connector 3.8 introduced a feature for tailoring a new app profile for users affected by slow performance, which turns on Redirect Web Traffic to Zscaler Client Connector Listening Proxy and turns off Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic in the Advanced Z-Tunnel Configuration menu while configuring the forwarding profile; web traffic then uses Z-Tunnel 1.0, non-web uses Z-Tunnel 2.0 and the forwarding profile PAC is not used.

quotes: Zscaler Client Connector version 3.8 introduced a feature that you can use to tailor a new app profile for specific users affected by slow performance issues.

The feature turns on Redirect Web Traffic to Zscaler Client Connector Listening Proxy and turns off Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic in the Advanced Z-Tunnel Configuration menu while configuring the forwarding profile.
Web traffic using Z-Tunnel 1.0.
Non-web traffic using Z-Tunnel 2.0.
Not using the forwarding profile Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) file.

hybrid-vs-recommend-both.summary: The runbook offers turning off Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic while Redirect Web Traffic to Zscaler Client Connector Listening Proxy is on as a workaround for UDP throttling; the forwarding profile page recommends enabling both options. The forwarding profile page still lists both options under the same names and describes the same Z-Tunnel 1.0 web result.

quotes: The feature turns on Redirect Web Traffic to Zscaler Client Connector Listening Proxy and turns off Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic in the Advanced Z-Tunnel Configuration menu while configuring the forwarding profile.

positions.says: As a workaround until the ISP resolves UDP throttling, the hybrid configuration turns Redirect Web Traffic to the listening proxy on and Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic off.

quotes: Zscaler recommends enabling both Redirect Web Traffic to Zscaler Client Connector Listening Proxy and Use Z-Tunnel 2.0 for Proxied Web Traffic.

hybrid-vs-recommend-both.impact: The hybrid configuration is a stated workaround for a UDP-throttling ISP, not the recommended setting; which applies to a given user depends on whether UDP throttling was confirmed.
